findings.title: The resume-commit security allowlist is not decision-complete
findings.reproduction: Run `git diff --name-status bf27fddd8e1732feadc698cd77f540ea9e1c7a0e..54d03055b1c6d9b702859d5fefbbac1e38de39df`; the exact governed resume transition modifies only docs/planning-implementation-plan.md, planning/backlog.yaml, planning/review-site/manifest.json, planning/review-site/waves/W1.html, and planning/status-summary.md. ECR-0003.md section 4.2 item 4 and ECR-0003.packet.json task criterion 4 require an `allowlisted resume-state-view diff`, but neither source enumerates those five paths or states that the committed resume must be their direct-child, modification-only diff. The static and generated review pages also omit the inventory. `planctl ecr validate ECR-0003` therefore passes while the security boundary remains open to materially different implementations of what counts as a related generated/state-view file. The packet separately requires extra commits and unrelated files to fail byte-stably, so an exact reviewer cannot determine conformance without inventing the missing allowlist after approval.
findings.requiredRemediation: Create a strict-descendant inert packet revision that enumerates exactly the five permitted resume-commit paths in the canonical proposal and machine packet, binds the candidate recovery HEAD as the direct child of the recorded pre-resume commit, requires modification-only changes to that exact inventory, and denies every added, deleted, renamed, substituted, or extra path. Reflect the same boundary in the static/generated human review surfaces, refresh all affected hashes, retain this R01 ledger append-only, and request a bounded R02 review. Do not execute B00 or T01, append W1.A04, release the hold, resume W1, or alter T03 while remediating the packet.
